purpose: Context-aware rejection of management-consulting, internet-operations, vague administrative, and generated boilerplate in formal soil and adjacent natural-science prose.
manual_exception_policy: Only source-locked quotations, official names, procurement clauses, interface terms, or defined technical senses may be allowlisted. The terms controlled by DR002 and DR026 have no defined-technical-sense exception in generated or translated prose. Record source and exact occurrence outside this file.
review_boundary: DR001-DR090 are established deterministic controls without a recorded independent human soil-domain review. DR091 and later are evidence-gathered candidate warnings; strict release blocks them until revision or a hash-bound source exception, but promotion to error requires independent human soil-domain review.
